title: Application Portal Opens for DLSEI Batch 3, Cohort 3 Registrations
text:
📢 Application Portal is Now Open!

Batch 3 – Cohort 3 of DLSEI registrations are now open.

The
Digital Learning and Skills Enrichment Initiative (DLSEI)
is a program by

Higher Education Commission (HEC) Pakistan
in collaboration with

Coursera
. It offers
free access to online courses

for students and faculty to enhance skills and career growth.

All students and faculty/staff are encouraged to apply.

🎓 Eligibility Criteria

Students enrolled in 16 years of education or above

Faculty members of public/private universities

Valid CNIC/B-Form required

Note:
Students must upload their official University Registration Card.

📝 How to Apply

Watch the video tutorial

Visit the registration portal

Fill and submit the form

Registration Link:

https://eservices.hec.gov.pk

📚 Additional Information

Program Details (https://dlsei.hec.gov.pk/)

FAQs (https://dlsei.hec.gov.pk/site/faqs)

Program Lifecycle (https://www.awkum.edu.pk/coursera.html)

⚠️
Important:
Applications are processed on a first-come, first-served basis.
Limited licenses are available.
